rect.title: O:prompt: the user's task instruction (trust: user)

path.title: O:user:2: user message arrives before T14; "Continue the original task to completion using the available native tools. The task has not been fully executed. Perform the remaining authorized work, verification and required report, then give the final result. Do not end with another announcement of future work. Preserve all original task requirements and restrictions. Do not change protected files."

svg.text: Tool results feed the next turn; thin connectors represent this history.
Lane color marks file origin. Dashed edges are inferences, not causal proof.
